result.rationale: The migration runs `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` without checking the result is non-empty. On fresh installs or sites that never set embed_category, no site_settings row exists for 'embed_category' (the removed default was ''), so `[0]` raises IndexError, aborting the migration for everyone. Even the fallback for category_id == 0 is unreachable because the exception occurs first. Verifiable directly from the diff lines in db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb.
